description:
mytool (version v1.2.3) is a command‑line utility for processing text files. It is packaged as a local dependency rather than a global script (global = false), and can be installed with the standard command `make install`. The primary executable script is `mytool.sh`, and the distribution also includes the documentation files `README.md` and `LICENSE`. At runtime the tool provides two commands: `run`, which executes `node run.js` (description: “Execute the main script.”), and `test`, which runs `npm test` (description: “Run the test suite.”).

The package depends on `bpkg-utils` at version v0.5.0 and on `libfoo` from the current `master` branch. For development it pulls in `bpkg-test` version v0.2.1. All of these dependencies are declared in the manifest so that the build environment can resolve them automatically.
